signed_rows.behavior: apm.yml lists the 13 rules and 3 skills aim managed, pinned to one jasperhg90/skills commit at or after f0813cd, with targets [claude], and apm.lock.yaml pins the full commit and each file's hash.
signed_rows.fails_when: apm.yml lacks any of the 13 rules or 3 skills, an entry is unpinned or pinned before f0813cd, targets is not [claude], or apm.lock.yaml is missing or lacks a resolved commit or file hashes

signed_rows.behavior: The installed rules and skills sit at the same paths as under aim, each rule keeps its path scoping and has the pinned upstream body, and each skill equals the pinned upstream folder.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of the 13 rules or 3 skills is missing from .claude/rules/ or .claude/skills/, a rule's paths: list differs from what aim installed (or a rule with none gains one), a rule body differs from the pinned upstream .instructions.md body, or a skill file differs from upstream at the pin

signed_rows.behavior: aim is gone: no aim.toml or aim.lock.toml, no aim: markers or aim header in AGENTS.md, and no file names aim; the guidelines text in AGENTS.md is otherwise unchanged.
signed_rows.fails_when: aim.toml or aim.lock.toml exists, AGENTS.md has an aim: marker or the aim header line, a tracked file outside .loop/ names agent-integrations-manager or aim as the manager, or the guidelines text changed beyond the markers and header
